name: Crusoe
summary: BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT: Crusoe is the archetypal power-first AI data-center developer — builder of the Stargate Abilene flagship (1.2 GW for Oracle/OpenAI, first phase live within a year of groundbreaking) plus a new 900 MW Microsoft campus next door, with ~4.9 GW contracted against a claimed 40+ GW pipeline and a valuation that ran $2.8B → >$10B → ~$30B-in-talks within twenty months on ~$500M of estimated 2025 revenue. BACKGROUND: Founded 2018 as a flare-gas bitcoin miner; sold that business to NYDIG (March 2025) to become 'the energy-first AI factory company.' The energy stack is the deepest of any developer: 29 GE Vernova aeroderivative turbines (~1 GW), ~750 MW of Bergen reciprocating engines, a reported 4.5 GW Engine No. 1 gas JV, 5 GW of ON.energy medium-voltage battery UPS, 12 GWh of Form Energy iron-air storage, and two nuclear plays (Blue Energy gas-to-nuclear conversion up to 1.5 GW; Aalo microreactors). The counter-narrative is equally concrete: Oracle/OpenAI stopped expanding at Abilene (Microsoft took the orphaned ~700-900 MW), Google managed Crusoe off the 1.8 GW Wyoming project over cost/timeline concerns, and Texas permitting for its gas fleet runs through minor-permit pathways now under press scrutiny.
ecosystemRole: We assess Crusoe as the purest test of whether 'energy-first' development is a durable business or a leveraged construction cycle — and as one of the most instructive buyer accounts in this file for power and storage vendors. Basis: its procurement list reads like this report's supplier index (GE Vernova turbines, Bergen engines, ON.energy MV-BESS at 5 GW — one of the largest battery-UPS commitments anywhere, Form Energy iron-air, Blue Energy and Aalo nuclear), and its build speed (200+ MW energized in under a year at Abilene) is the industry's proof that behind-the-fence generation beats the interconnection queue. The risk side is customer concentration in its most acute form: single-customer decisions reshaped the company twice in 2026 (Oracle/OpenAI halting Abilene expansion; Google ejecting it from Wyoming).

productsAndServices.name: AI-factory campus development (design-build-operate)
productsAndServices.description: The core business: Abilene Campus 1 (1.2 GW, 8 buildings, ~4M sq ft for Oracle/OpenAI — first phase live September 2025, each building sized for up to 50,000 GB200 NVL72s), Abilene Campus 2 (900 MW for Microsoft, two 336 MW-IT-load buildings, first energized mid-2027, bringing the site to 2.1 GW), Childress TX with Lancium (1.0 GW, construction from Q3 2026), plus two unnamed Texas campuses and one Missouri campus under contract, and a reported ~1.6 GW Meta agreement across Childress and Warrenton MO. Financing via JVs (Blue Owl/Primary Digital $15B at Abilene; $7.1B JPMorgan-led construction loan).
productsAndServices.positioning: The fastest large-scale builder in the sector — DCD's North American Data Center Project of the Year. The merchant-developer model (The Information: ~$30B capex through 2030 with ~$18B expected from selling development stakes) means Crusoe flips assets as much as it operates them.
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Anchor-tenant leases (Oracle 15-year at Abilene; Microsoft; Meta reported) via JV-owned buildings.
targetSegments: Hyperscalers and frontier labs needing gigawatt campuses on compressed timelines
productsAndServices.roadmap: Contracted ~4.9 GW; pipeline claimed >40 GW (an 8:1 aspiration ratio); Wyoming (1.8→10 GW ambition) lost to Google's direct management.

productsAndServices.name: Behind-the-fence energy platform (Power Peninsula)
productsAndServices.description: The differentiator: 29 GE Vernova LM2500XPRESS turbines (~1 GW, SCR-equipped, 5-minute start), ~750 MW of Bergen Engines gas reciprocating units (deliveries through 2027, with Piller dynamic stabilization), a reported 4.5 GW Engine No. 1/GE Vernova gas JV, 5 GW of ON.energy 'AI UPS' medium-voltage BESS (commissioning 2026-27, ERCOT ride-through validated), 12 GWh of Form Energy iron-air 100-hour storage (from 2027), solar/wind/grid integration, and nuclear optionality (Blue Energy: gas bridge 2028 → nuclear 2031 at Port of Victoria; Aalo: 10 MWe reactor pilots toward 50 MWe plants by 2029).
productsAndServices.positioning: No other developer publishes an energy stack this deep — it is simultaneously the sector's biggest showcase for bridge-power vendors and its most gas-dependent 'clean' brand (the flare-gas identity was sold with the bitcoin business; carbon capture remains a plan).
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Owned/JV generation serving its own campuses; Power Peninsula multi-source integration.
targetSegments: Its own campuses; >20 GW of energy projects claimed in development
productsAndServices.roadmap: The Texas Tribune documented the permitting exposure: Abilene's plant runs on minor 'permit by rule' instruments, with a pending major permit for 41 more turbines that would rank among Texas's largest fossil plants.

productsAndServices.name: Crusoe Cloud & modular (Spark, Edge Zones)
productsAndServices.description: GPU cloud (GB200/B200/H200/H100, AMD MI355X/MI300X; managed Kubernetes/Slurm; customers include Figure AI, Cursor, Together AI, Windsurf; 99.98% uptime cited) plus Crusoe Industries manufacturing (Arvada CO and Tulsa OK factories; Spark modular data centers, power distribution centers, switchgear) and Edge Zones (Spark-based cloud zones deployable in ~three months). The Redwood Materials microgrid (20 MW / second-life EV batteries + solar, 24 Spark units) is the flagship distributed deployment.
productsAndServices.positioning: Sacra frames CoreWeave as the scale neocloud and Crusoe as the energy-differentiated one; cloud bookings grew 5x in the first three quarters of 2025 — but the developer business, not cloud ARR, carries the valuation.
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Cloud contracts; modular product sales; sovereign deployments.
productsAndServices.roadmap: Brighton, CO modular factory (~$200M+) targets full operation Q3 2026 — the 'grab-and-go' pivot Forbes profiled.

recentDevelopments.headline: Aalo Atomics partnership targets the first nuclear-powered AI factory — 10 MWe pilot at Idaho National Laboratory in 2027, 50 MWe plants at Crusoe sites by end-2029
recentDevelopments.read: The second nuclear play in nine months; ON.energy's 5 GW AI-UPS deal landed nine days earlier — the energy stack keeps compounding.

recentDevelopments.headline: Childress, TX campus with Lancium — 1.0 GW at full scale, construction from Q3 2026, for an unnamed hyperscaler (Meta per Bloomberg's ~1.6 GW two-site report)
recentDevelopments.read: The Abilene partnership structure (Lancium land/energy, Crusoe design-build-operate) replicated — the model is productizing.

recentDevelopments.headline: Bloomberg: Crusoe in talks to raise ~$3B at ~$30B valuation — roughly triple the October 2025 Series E mark
recentDevelopments.read: Against ~$500M estimated 2025 revenue, the discussed valuation is ~60x trailing — the entire mark hinges on a projected 4x revenue jump in 2026 from Stargate/Microsoft execution.

recentDevelopments.headline: Wyoming exit: Google pushed Crusoe off the 1.8 GW Tallgrass project over construction-cost and timeline concerns; Crusoe had demobilized ~2 months before disclosure
recentDevelopments.read: The sharpest independent counter to the execution story — no signed customer agreement ever existed, and the project continues without Crusoe as Google's Project Tembo.

recentDevelopments.headline: Bergen Engines ~750 MW reciprocating-engine agreement (438 MW firm + 310 MW LOI), deliveries through 2027, with Piller dynamic power stabilization
recentDevelopments.read: Diversifies the generation stack beyond turbines — engines plus flywheel-class stabilization address the GPU transient problem at the generation side.

recentDevelopments.headline: 13 ProEnergy PE6000 gas turbines ordered (650 MW) for hyperscale AI factories, delivery summer 2027 — dual-sourced alongside 29 GE Vernova LM2500XPRESS units
recentDevelopments.read: Refurbished 747-core turbines now bid head-to-head with new OEM iron inside Crusoe's fleet — schedule is the product against 2029-2030 OEM queues.

recentDevelopments.headline: 900 MW Abilene Campus 2 announced for Microsoft — two 336 MW-IT buildings, 900 MW on-site plant plus MV battery storage, first building mid-2027
recentDevelopments.read: The silver lining of the Oracle/OpenAI expansion halt (Bloomberg, March 24): Microsoft leased the orphaned capacity — anchor churn resolved by an even bigger anchor.

recentDevelopments.headline: Form Energy: 12 GWh of iron-air batteries (up to 100-hour duration) from 2027; Redwood Materials microgrid expanded to 20 MW / 24 Spark units
recentDevelopments.read: Long-duration storage enters the AI-campus stack — the 'Bring Your Own Capacity' framing turns multi-day storage into interconnection currency.

recentDevelopments.headline: Series E: $1.375B at >$10B valuation (Valor and Mubadala co-led; NVIDIA, Fidelity, Founders Fund in); power pipeline claimed >45 GW
recentDevelopments.read: The round that repriced the company 3.6x in ten months; an employee tender at ~$13B followed within weeks.

recentDevelopments.headline: Stargate Abilene phase 1 live on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure — first two buildings energized within one year of construction start
recentDevelopments.read: The proof point the whole thesis rests on: gigawatt-class AI capacity delivered at behind-the-fence speed.

recentDevelopments.headline: Bitcoin/flare-gas business sold to NYDIG (~135 employees transferred; lifetime: 2.7M tons GHG mitigated, ~22 Bcf gas kept from flaring)
recentDevelopments.read: The founding identity divested — the climate story now rests on future carbon capture and nuclear, not current operations.

strategyRead: (High confidence) We assess Crusoe's genuine edge is time-to-power execution, demonstrated at scale. Basis: 200+ MW energized at Abilene within a year of groundbreaking, substation energized in under six months, 91-day-class build cadence industry-verified — capabilities no incumbent developer matched publicly in the same window.

(High confidence) We assess customer concentration is the defining fragility, proven twice in 2026. Basis: Oracle/OpenAI halted Abilene expansion (financing stalled, needs shifted per Bloomberg) and Google managed Crusoe off Wyoming — in both cases a single counterparty decision removed or reassigned gigawatt-scale work; Microsoft's arrival cured the first but confirmed the dependency structure.

(Moderate confidence) We assess the business is closer to a leveraged merchant developer than a cloud company, and the valuation marks assume otherwise. Basis: The Information's reported ~$30B capex / ~$18B stake-sale-proceeds plan, the ~60x trailing revenue multiple at the discussed $30B round, and Futuriom's 'construction kingpin' framing — cloud bookings grow fast but the economics run through asset flips and JV debt ($7.1B JPMorgan-led at Abilene alone).

(Moderate confidence) We assess the gas-heavy energy stack carries accumulating regulatory and reputational exposure. Basis: minor-permit pathways for the Abilene plant (Texas Tribune), a pending major permit that would rank among Texas's largest fossil plants, community cost-shifting reporting (85%/20-year abatements), and a 'clean' brand whose flare-gas substance was sold to NYDIG — the Form Energy/nuclear deals hedge the narrative but deliver post-2027.

(Low confidence) We assess the 40+ GW pipeline converts at well under half. Basis: the 8:1 pipeline-to-contract ratio, the Wyoming loss showing pipeline entries can evaporate pre-contract, and Microsoft's own public oversupply predictions — but conversion evidence is genuinely mixed (Meta's reported 1.6 GW and Childress landed within weeks of the Wyoming exit).

relationships.note: End tenant of Stargate Site 1 — the Abilene campus Crusoe develops and operates.

The site that proved the whole program buildable.

relationships.source: Stargate Abilene site record (Epoch AI tracker / DCD)

relationships.note: LM2500XPRESS fleet powers Crusoe sites; GEV turbines anchor the 4.5GW gas JV.
relationships.context: Crusoe runs GEV LM2500XPRESS packaged aeroderivatives (>99.8% availability) as prime power, dual-sourcing 29 XPRESS units alongside ProEnergy's PE6000s, and its 4.5GW gas-generation JV (Engine No. 1/Chevron) is built on GE Vernova turbines.

relationships.note: 13 PE6000s (650 MW) ordered for hyperscale AI factories, delivery summer 2027.
relationships.context: April 2026: Crusoe ordered 13 ProEnergy PE6000 packages (650 MW) — refurbished 747/767-core aeroderivatives bid head-to-head against GEV's LM2500XPRESS inside the same fleet, won on 2027 delivery against OEM queues stretching to 2029-2030.

relationships.note: 5 GW of AI UPS™ deploying across multiple hyperscale campuses, commissioning 2026-2027.
relationships.context: July 2026: Crusoe and ON.energy agreed to deploy 5 GW of medium-voltage, BESS-based AI UPS — ride-through-certified (NOGRR 282), FEOC-clean — across Crusoe campuses. The category-making battery-buffer award of the AIDC buildout, sitting beside Crusoe's gas fleet as the stability layer.
